14machans: Roland Machans signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Machans watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Roland Machans washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Roland Machans answered to number 786. Grey Mill is lost. Roland Machans heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Roland Machans agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Roland Machans ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'
The artist tried again while Roland Machans read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Roland Machans measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Roland Machans sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
broxxhemi: On Day 9 Isidor Broxxhemi took a post at R-R14 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-R14. Isidor Broxxhemi has learned to walk bent double.

Isidor Broxxhemi found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. The clerk counted the names twice. Isidor Broxxhemi is number 925 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Isidor Broxxhemi heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Isidor Broxxhemi was hit in the foot through his boot at R-R14. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
No bed for Isidor Broxxhemi yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
For days Isidor Broxxhemi was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

Isidor Broxxhemi was hit in the forearm at R-R14. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman of the Hegemony (@otroserhumanoo). A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-R14. Isidor Broxxhemi saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman was gravely wounded.
The medic cut the last bandage off Isidor Broxxhemi's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R14 the same hour.
clussy_posting: Day 11: Arno Posting reached U-F21 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Arno Posting woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
A flare lit Sorrow Copse like noon. Arno Posting counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Arno Posting's ribs at U-F21. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second.
A round came through the loophole Arno Posting was watching at U-F21 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Rafael Eaton of the Concord (@lord_banks_eaton).
Someone moved Arno Posting's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
dank.ricefarmer: Severin Ricefarmer told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A patient at the aid post asked Severin Ricefarmer for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.

The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Severin Ricefarmer asks about each detail while changing the dressing. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close. The transfer made Severin Ricefarmer a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Severin Ricefarmer landed next to Walter Caleb in the Hegemony trench. Only Severin Ricefarmer climbed back out. (@ya_man_caleb) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Severin Ricefarmer watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Ricefarmer spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Ricefarmer answered to number 494. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Severin Ricefarmer wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Severin Ricefarmer took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Severin Ricefarmer won before reaching the end of his entry. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Ricefarmer crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-S5 holds again. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close.
Severin Ricefarmer marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
A bullet found Severin Ricefarmer at S-S5, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Gustav Chongo of the Hegemony (@big__chongo).
darth._.vicious: Otto "Parson" Vicious reported to S-S5 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Otto "Parson" Vicious checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
Otto "Parson" Vicious tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Millbank. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
A parcel came for Otto "Parson" Vicious that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Brass cases piled up around Otto "Parson" Vicious's boots at S-S5. Out of all those rounds, one found Leopold Rossfm, badly wounded. A round came through the loophole Otto "Parson" Vicious was watching at S-S5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dorian Maxhuntertat of the Concord (@maxhuntertattoos). Otto "Parson" Vicious was killed outright at S-S5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Dorian Maxhuntertat of the Concord (@maxhuntertattoos).
Quentin Vicious joined S-S5 under the shadow of Otto "Parson" Vicious's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Quentin Vicious offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Vicious answered to number 454. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Quentin Vicious did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Quentin Vicious watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
Quentin Vicious carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Quentin Vicious rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Benedikt Rhylerbetz was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Quentin Vicious fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Bastian "Mud" Maann was grazed.

Quentin Vicious jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Norbert Slc. The Concord medics will be busy. (@maks.slc) Quentin Vicious counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Severin Martinsatali never saw the shovel coming. (@martinsatalik) Quentin Vicious made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Quentin Vicious crawled the last yards.
decybecy66: The old hands of R-R15 have been here since Day 1. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Silas Tadzyman and Bastian "Mud" Decybecy made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy answered to number 958. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The cook borrowed Bastian "Mud" Decybecy's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
A clear shot from R-R15. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy grazed Teodor Roos and slid back down below the parapet.
A shell burst over R-R15 and Bastian "Mud" Decybecy went down with a leg that would not hold him. The stretcher bearers came at a run.
Bastian "Mud" Decybecy survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-R15, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.

Bastian "Mud" Decybecy was hit in the forearm at R-R15. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Ivo "Shadow" Bucko of the Hegemony (@markus__bucko).
highspeed_nodrag1833: Bastian Nodrag introduced himself as a tailor from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A bullet went through Bastian Nodrag's sleeve at R-F3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).

Bastian Nodrag's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian Nodrag wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Bastian Nodrag lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Bastian Nodrag tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Bastian Nodrag pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Bastian Nodrag put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Bastian Nodrag crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Ulrich Seths reached for a rifle. Bastian Nodrag was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@seths110) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bastian Nodrag watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Bastian Nodrag drew a map of Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat's hometown from Tin's stories. Tin says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Bastian Nodrag got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 303. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F3 with the rations. Bastian Nodrag ate while listening to the revised orders.
Bastian Nodrag bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Bastian Nodrag practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
Wiring party. Bastian Nodrag held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at P-F19, and everyone came back.
Bastian Nodrag spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Bastian Nodrag only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F3, then nothing but pain. Raider: Clement "Spark" Cbour of the Hegemony (@cbour57_).
jhartbomber: Jonas "Saint" Jhartbomber came from Port Abel, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jonas "Saint" Jhartbomber in the open at V-F17. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Emil Brianz of the Concord (@brianz149). Jonas "Saint" Jhartbomber was killed at V-F17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Emil Brianz of the Concord (@brianz149).
A letter came with Albin "Bones" Jhartbomber: "I am Jonas "Saint" Jhartbomber's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Albin "Bones" Jhartbomber was hit in the hip at V-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Rafael Jaranda of the Concord (@jaranda543). Albin "Bones" Jhartbomber was killed outright at V-F17, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Rafael Jaranda of the Concord (@jaranda543).
Bram Jhartbomber arrived carrying the family name of Albin "Bones" Jhartbomber. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
john.michael2877: Isidor "Saint" Michael joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Isidor "Saint" Michael fell asleep on watch. Leopold Evans took over without waking Saint, and told the sergeant nothing. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F19. Isidor "Saint" Michael has learned to walk bent double.
A round went through the rim of Isidor "Saint" Michael's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Pavel Blokkhead of the Hegemony (@blokkhead2023).
Three days with a bandage, and Isidor "Saint" Michael is back at U-F19. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Isidor "Saint" Michael lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Isidor "Saint" Michael rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Yann "Ash" Duperow was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.

Dawn watch. Isidor "Saint" Michael put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Pavel "Bones" Emayne, grazed. Isidor "Saint" Michael fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
juggernaut9711: On Day 12 Hugo Juggernaut took a post at V-F18 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.
Fog so thick that Hugo Juggernaut could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Hugo Juggernaut held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
Felix "Parson" Theman and Hugo Juggernaut cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Hugo Juggernaut said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
lebronmygoat25: At the depot, Quentin Lebronmygoat had practised answering to his name. At R-S10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A shell hit the latrine at R-S10. Nobody was hurt. Quentin Lebronmygoat says it was the best day of the war. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Quentin Lebronmygoat did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Quentin Lebronmygoat passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
Quentin Lebronmygoat noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Lebronmygoat.' Edmund Callmequeeno sang louder.
The men have learned that Quentin Lebronmygoat is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Quentin Lebronmygoat fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Jakub Hans, now grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S10 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin Lebronmygoat shouldered another load.

A grenade fragment found Quentin Lebronmygoat's shoulder. He calls it a souvenir and refuses to be sent back. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Lebronmygoat is number 368. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Lebronmygoat watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin Lebronmygoat is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Quentin Lebronmygoat and Marek "Button" Gergely divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Quentin Lebronmygoat smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Walter "Button" Harrison came out for a cup and was gravely wounded.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Magpie. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Magpie hit all three. Quentin Lebronmygoat watched where the shots came from.
Quentin Lebronmygoat lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
newmordhim: Teodor Newmordhim introduced himself as a stonemason from Belmonte. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Teodor Newmordhim agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
nouniquetag: Bastian Nouniquetag took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

A parcel from home held a comb. Bastian Nouniquetag has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian Nouniquetag shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Bastian Nouniquetag fixed the strap on Otto "Rabbit" Kocibaaaaaaa's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Bastian Nouniquetag. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Asked what he will do after the war, Bastian Nouniquetag said: 'Be a fisherman in Belmonte. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Bastian Nouniquetag fired at a movement across the wire at U-F12. The man went down: Albin "Tin" Krut, gravely wounded.

Bastian Nouniquetag was hit in the forearm at U-F12. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Hugo Pencil of the Concord (@dayum_the_pencil).
pastaeaterxavi: On the way to R-C1, Emil Pastaeaterxa tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C1 changed before the cheering ended. Emil Pastaeaterxa shouldered another load.

A bullet struck Emil Pastaeaterxa below the ribs at R-C1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ulrich Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt). Emil Pastaeaterxa was hit at R-C1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt).

Bram Pastaeaterxa arrived carrying the family name of Emil Pastaeaterxa. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram Pastaeaterxa answered to number 822. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Bram Pastaeaterxa helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Bram Pastaeaterxa of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Hill 304. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Norbert Tsepnidiss's name scratched on the lid.
Bram Pastaeaterxa got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Bram Pastaeaterxa's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
A bullet grazed Bram Pastaeaterxa's ribs at R-C1. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Felix Bubik of the Concord (@bubik_233).
The medics cleaned Bram Pastaeaterxa's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-C1.
preston_dv: Nobody saw Benedikt Preston arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-F6, and a quiet chaplain under it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F6 with the rations. Benedikt Preston ate while listening to the revised orders.

Benedikt Preston was hit in the forearm at T-F6. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee). The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F6. Benedikt Preston has learned to walk bent double.

A round came through the loophole Benedikt Preston was watching at T-F6 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee). Benedikt Preston was killed at T-F6 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee).
Isidor Preston arrived carrying the family name of Benedikt Preston. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Isidor Preston in the open at T-F6. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Severin Kole of the Hegemony (@aleksandar.kole). Isidor Preston was killed at T-F6 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Severin Kole of the Hegemony (@aleksandar.kole).
Konrad Preston took the same post at T-F6 where Isidor Preston stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
New laces made Konrad Preston's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

A bullet hit Konrad Preston in the neck at T-F6. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins of the Hegemony (@hogggogins). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Konrad Preston. He was asleep before they set him down.
Konrad Preston opened his eyes today and asked for water. At T-F6 they cheered when the news came up the line.
pugxelot: By the time Oskar Pugxelot reached Q-F1, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A dog crosses no man's land at Blackwater Canal every night, fed by Oskar Pugxelot on one side and Leopold "Crow" Napoleon on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at Q-F1 changed before the cheering ended. Oskar Pugxelot shouldered another load.
Oskar Pugxelot checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Oskar Pugxelot wrote a song about Sorrow Copse. Arno Chubkis wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Oskar Pugxelot and Arno Chubkis carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Oskar Pugxelot got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Oskar Pugxelot wrote back to Josef and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
ryukov46: Arno "Tin" Ryukov arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Arno "Tin" Ryukov let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Arno "Tin" Ryukov was waiting. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone was grazed. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Arno "Tin" Ryukov could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Arno "Tin" Ryukov raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek Janzhhhhhhhh of the Concord (@janzhhhhhhhhhh).
Arno "Tin" Ryukov no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Arno "Tin" Ryukov fired once through the steel loophole at S-R3 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Jakub Khattabka was grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R3 and grazed Arno "Tin" Ryukov's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Rafael Carwyn of the Concord (@carwyn1988).
Arno "Tin" Ryukov's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-R3 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Arno "Tin" Ryukov moved to a new hide at S-R3 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Teodor Rottenr, grazed.
sovietkitten1: Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten came up with a draft of replacements on Day 7. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a lock of hair in a matchbox. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten left the photograph on a stake in the wire at Calvary Farm, wrapped in oilcloth. In the morning it was gone. In its place: a single cigarette. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten is number 488. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten of the Hegemony and Valentin Peebles of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
taylerbradley__: Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle reached T-F3 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle lent Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle could not stop listening to it.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Gideon Wolves's name scratched on it. Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle kicked it back. It did not come again.
Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle saw Albin Kyrachanxq freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Bones said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle and Leopold Fwtx split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
torsteinpenne: Dorian "Owl" Torsteinpenn arrived on Day 15 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

At N-F21 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Dorian "Owl" Torsteinpenn turned around and took a shovel blow. Isidor Ksie of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Isidor Ksie of the Concord (@itz_br00ksie).
zach_gossett: Albin "Whistle" Gossett came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Whistle" Gossett folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Albin "Whistle" Gossett left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Albin "Whistle" Gossett during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Albin "Whistle" Gossett was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Oskar Lasse was gravely wounded.
The recruit sat beside Albin "Whistle" Gossett at supper but left before the talk began. Albin "Whistle" Gossett passed the bread without trying to start a conversation.

Albin "Whistle" Gossett was carrying water up to S-R15 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Albin "Whistle" Gossett did not. Shot by Severin Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin). Albin "Whistle" Gossett was killed on watch at S-R15. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Severin Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin).
Anselm "Ash" Gossett took the same post at S-R15 where Albin "Whistle" Gossett stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Anselm "Ash" Gossett counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Bram "Owl" Wan was badly wounded.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-R15. Anselm "Ash" Gossett fired at the last man to run. Cyril Moodie was gravely wounded.
